summary: Frontend-only mobile-web validation completed on preview URL for global Tamil/English propagation and native/web date-time picker behavior. Most requested flows passed; Panchangam content API returned 501 in preview.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 501 ("Daily Panchangam is not available in this build") during UI integration flow.

integration_issues.issue: Screen language and date picker work, but Panchangam data fetch fails due backend 501.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning repeats: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents

action_items: Fix backend Panchangam availability in preview so /api/panchangam/{date} does not return 501.
Add missing testID attributes to interactive elements in Compatibility/Account/Profiles (inputs and action buttons) to improve testability and regression coverage.
Optional cleanup: remove pointerEvents deprecated prop usage to reduce runtime warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Global language provider wiring is correct across Home, Horoscope, Compatibility, Panchangam, Saved Charts, and Account; toggle propagation works in both directions.

NativeDateTimePicker web fallback uses numeric day/month/year + hour/minute inputs with confirm/cancel and shared picker IDs, and behaved correctly in Horoscope/Compatibility/Panchangam picker-open flows.
Several interactive controls still lack testID (e.g., Compatibility text inputs, Account modal actions, Profiles action controls), which violates mobile testability standards for RN web automation.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (all requested UI/state/picker checks passed except Panchangam data integration)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Language propagation and date/time picker behavior are stable across tested screens/viewports (390x844 and 320x700). Re-test Panchangam screen after backend endpoint availability fix; then re-run full mobile propagation suite.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: Navigate Home -> Panchangam in English state. Console shows failed resource 501 and ApiError: 'Daily Panchangam is not available in this build.' Root cause appears backend feature disabled/unavailable in deployed preview build, not a frontend picker or localization regression.
